intro.text: Lord Augustin Tekiel, a leading member of House Tekiel.

items.text: For about two years Tekiel avoided aluminum taxes by having railway workers help him pass the metal off as other goods, such as wool. The Vanishers somehow learned of the scheme and robbed a train carrying one of these shipments, gaining aluminum for their weapons and money besides.

Afraid that attention would expose him, Tekiel waited three months before complaining about the theft, then published an open letter in several broadsheets condemning the constables as incompetent. Studying the Vanisher robberies, Wax worked out the fraud by deduction.
